verdict.rationale: Controlling context memory allocation across concurrent model instances is a fair question for an LLM inference engine like llama.cpp, so the axis applies. The pack does not document it: there is no evidence of KV-cache or context-size controls, per-instance memory budgeting, or parallel-slot allocation. The quantization, CPU+GPU hybrid offload and mmap RAM-reduction items are adjacent memory features, not context-allocation control for concurrent instances.
